---
title: Integrations
description: Toolchain and third-party package integrations.
---

Rimelight UI integrates with standard tools and utilities in the modern web ecosystem to accelerate development workflows.

## Features

- **Vite Plugins**: virtual module plugin for config resolution.
- **UnoCSS Preset**: Tailwind v4-style utility classes.
- **Lunaria & Knip**: Translation tracking and unused code detection.
